title: Research notes
description: This is an editorial summary of new research published during October 2026. It describes the research, why readers might care, and the limitations of the evidence. The material is intended to be educational and does not assert that any system has reached general intelligence. We include links to original dated reports and explain the difference between research from a company and findings that have been independently evaluated. Readers should verify sources and not infer broad capability from a narrow benchmark. Each research note will identify what the finding does not prove. OpenAI and Anthropic publish research updates, and our public newsletter can discuss those releases with clear attribution and editorial caution.
